name: frontier-infra
description: Design, govern, build, and audit reliable AI harnesses using Frontier Infra standards and evidence-bound patterns.

interface.shortDescription: Design governed AI harnesses with checkable evidence.
interface.longDescription: A developer field kit for reliable AI harnesses: philosophy, architecture patterns, sprint contracts, deterministic drivers, fresh workers, independent verification, governance gates, reversibility, runtime health, AAR receipts, AVL ground truth, conformance audits, and repository operating controls. Conformance claims remain shape-stamped and evidence-bound.
defaultPrompt: Design a reliable AI harness for my workflow.
Audit my agent system against The Machine.
Add governance gates and evidence to my agents.
